description: PRIOT Digital Systems (https://priot.io/) is Slovenia's research and development company. entityDescription:
As the challenge of orbital debris or “space junk” is set to grow, there is an urgent need to address the question of debris management, ensure the safety of the current working satellites, and innovate for the production and monitoring of future satellites. 
The Space Sustainability Rating (SSR) is an initiative seeking to foster voluntary actions by satellite operators to reduce the risks related to space debris and on-orbit collisions providing: 
A rating system informed by transparent, data-based assessments of the level of sustainability of space missions 
Practical guidance on how to improve sustainability performance & practices 
A platform for action-focused collaboration centered on the rating system to support research and leverage best practices 
The SSR supports space actors, such as governments, space agencies, and commercial companies, in understanding the impact of their activities on the space environment, identifying opportunities to minimize those impacts and taking an active role in making space safer and more sustainable, for all.

entityDescription:
TETMET was born from the observation that metallic structures could be optimized in three dimensions in particular: the quantity of material used, the quantity of energy used in the production process and the logistic effort required to transport finished goods over long distances. 
TETMET opens lattice structures to many industries, including luxury, design and architecture as well as construction, space, naval and aeronautic. 
 
The traditional topological optimisation approach consists in removing material where it is not needed, in order to gain mass. The production of optimized structures via a subtractive approach result in a massive energy consumption and a large amount of waste. 3D printing (WAAM for metal or lit-powder) consists in adding material only where needed require a considerable amount of energy to keep the material at the liquid state, or to atomize the raw material to make it a powder. 
Lattice structures only use the strict necessary quantity of material, without later addition or subtraction. They are produced by assembling metallic rods through laser welding, a process using very little energy. 
 
In other words, TETMET enables the additive manufacturing of large size objects with 40% less material and 90% less energy than 3D printing. 
 
TETMET’s flexible toolchain allows decentralized production. The machines producing the pieces may be located anywhere and are actioned by a service hosted in the cloud. It is therefore possible to produce closer to the object’s final destination and therefore avoid the complexity and the cost of transporting large items. 
 
Finally, it goes without saying that the savings on the three dimensions have a significant impact on the carbon footprint of the final products. 
 
 
 
TETMET’ toolchain encompasses: 
- The digital generation of optimized lattice structures
- A beam steering system
- A robotic arm, on which the laser is mounted
- The machine-learning and constant improvement

entityDescription:
For the recerationnal boating, the accidental grounding (when a ship hits the bottom of the sea) is the 2nd cause of SAR (Search and rescue) interventions at sea, the 1st expenditure budget for insurances companies with an average of 8000€ repair cost per accident.
Some solutions have been around for many years, but have not evolved much. They fail to adress the need to improve safety at sea for a ever growing population of sailors, who are also less and less savvy on the water: As a result, we see a x3 growth in grounding over the last 10 years (source: Insurance companies).
To achieve this, we've designed the following solution:RS Nautic 360 is a smart solution presenting itself as an electronic applicance, mounted on the boat dashboard. Using an embedded GPS module, it helps to calculate with accuracy the water level available above the sea bed ahaed of the boat. It triggers an alarm up to 180 seconds before an anticipated impact.

R Systems was founded in november 2019 to developp a project - RS AERO - aimed at securing helicopters flights in hazardous areas where powerlines are posing a threat to the aircraft.
During our incubation at DECA BFC, there was a compelling incentive to leverage our technology and target another market: RS Nautic was born from this initiative.

entityDescription:
The core business of Wave S.r.l. is the development of radiofrequency and microwave electronic circuits targeted to the space, telecommunication and defence markets.
Wave S.r.l. was born in 2005, in Rome, Italy. During 18 years Wave has developed specific competences both in the design of Monolithic Microwave Integrated Circuit (MMIC) and Hybrid Integrated Microwave Modules (HMIC). Wave know-how and experience spans from UHF to 60GHz. Since 2007 the company manufacture and sells wireless devices for telecommunication network in urban and rural scenarios.
Company competences spans through different sectors, the most significant are:
- Solid State Power Amplifier (SSPA) for space, defence, radar and telecommunication applications
- Datalink (UAV, Defence, Mobile) RF modules, channel emulators, 5G, IoT and ISM applications
- Microwave Modules: Low Noise Amplifiers, Synthesizers, Mixer ecc.. dedicated to: automatic test equipment (ATE), SATCOM, 5G, IoT
- SATCOM Applications: Receivers, LNAs, BUC and SSPAs for fixed and mobile terminals
- GaN and GaAs MMICs for space, defence and telecommunication markets

Wave is fully equipped with a manufacturing and testing microwave facility. The Facility is composed by two main working centers: precision mecanics CNC and microelectrics/RF PCB qualified for production, reworking, testing and tuning of complex microwave modules operating in space and defence markets.
Since 2018 Wave has been ISO9001:2015 qualified for both mechanics and electronics design and manufacturing.

MediaTek is a fabless semiconductor company, which is another way of saying we design chips for electronic devices that our partners manufacture.
We design cutting-edge system-on-chip (SoC) solutions for cellular handsets and tablet devices; fixed and wireless connectivity; high-definition TV; optical storage and DVD and Blu-ray products.
MediaTek is headquartered in Taiwan and has sales and research subsidiaries in mainland China, Singapore, India, U.S., Japan, South Korea, Denmark, the UK, Sweden and Dubai. Our R&D centre in Cambourne (near Cambridge) develops smartphone SW and cellular system technology, and our R&D centre in Kent develops RF technology. MTK Wireless Ltd is the UK operation of MediaTek Inc. In the UK, we have two R&D centers – both working on technology for our future SoC wireless chipsets. Our R&D centre in Cambourne (near Cambridge) develops SW and system technology, and our R&D centre in Kent develops RF technology

MediaTek'sWirelessProducts
MediaTek has cumulatively shipped well over 2.5Bn cellular chipsets since entering the cellular market segment less than a decade ago. MediaTek’s “total solution” turnkey approach, and insatiable appetite for excellence in modem solutions, has enabled our customers to successfully deploy MediaTek powered handsets in over 150 countries worldwide. Most recently, our 3G chipsets have been at the forefront of enabling the democratization of smartphones for the mass market. In addition to cellular chipsets, MediaTek has developed leading edge wireless connectivity technology, including Wi-Fi, BT GPS and NFC.
MediaTekin the UK
MediaTek has two sites in the UK contributing to the companies development of wireless handset technology -
- The R&D site in Cambourne: the Cambridge team focuses on Protocol Stack and Multimedia software development and systems-level development and test.
- The R&D site in West Malling, Kent: the Kent team develop RF technology, including multimode cellular transceivers.

Tuebingen is a place of research and learning. It has been since 1477. Tuebingen is among the world’s foremost universities and expressly supports common European values. These include the freedom of research and academia, the freedom of expression, the equality of all human beings and respect for human dignity, regardless of a person’s origins, religion, social status, gender, or sexual orientation. The University of Tuebingen actively supports positive developments in society and peaceful coexistence, sustainable development, and the protection of the environment.
We regard the diversity of our students and employees as a great strength. It is our paramount task to support them in their quest for knowledge and education. An important factor in the success of a university is the motivation of its employees. With this in mind, the University makes every effort to enable its students and employees to reconcile the demands of family with their studies and working lives.
The University of Tuebingen is committed to the highest standards of research and teaching across a broad spectrum of subjects.
- The University encourages interdisciplinary and international cooperation and upholds academic freedom in research and teaching, while acknowledging that the search for knowledge must be ethical.
- The University regards variety as essential to academic excellence and therefore supports equality between its members.
- It also provides further training in a variety of fields to equip its members with necessary non-academic skills.

The incorporation date is as stated here not 1755 but 1477 - the system do not accept an earlier date.

entityDescription:
I am a freelance user experience designer working in collaboration with technology companies in the development of applications for mobile devices. With more than 20 years of experience in the digital communication and journalism sector.

The lack of projects led me to work as a day labourer in the olive harvest in Cordoba (Spain) in the 2022-2023 campaign. There I discovered what agricultural work is like and how alien it is to new technologies, as it is an almost virgin sector in this sense, at least in the area where I worked.

But I also discovered that agriculture and farmers can improve their working conditions, make tasks more efficient and sustainable and increase the yield of their farms if they take advantage of the benefits offered by new technologies and, of course, satellite communications.

Since agriculture came into my life, all I think about is how to improve it because it is the basic pillar for humanity.

I have developed a prototype of a mobile application that would reduce the uncertainty of day labourers to know the days they work due to the weather.

I am also planning to develop another prototype that would help the farmer-entrepreneur to manage agricultural and financial work while allowing the owner of the farm to have a detailed knowledge of all the work being done on each plot.

Garnica Facility Services was founded in Bilbao in 1979 and is present in Spain, Portugal, Angola and Chile and employs 3.200 people.
Garnica Facility Services helps its clients to achieve their goals in the following areas:
- Cleaning Services
- Office Support Services
- Gardening
- Pest Control Services
- Environmental Services

GARNICA strive to deliver industry best practice across all our service lines whilst driving out best possible value for our clients. During these years we have been successful in:
•Understanding our clients needs. •Meeting clients requirements in terms of quality standards. •Achieving cost efficiency measures. •Implementing customized service packages for our clients. •Innovating and implementing new product and services methods. 

Values:
•People: active investment in recruitment, retention and development of our main asset. •Deliver best practices accross all our services whilst driving added value for our clients. •Build long term relationships with our customers and our people based on transparency and trust. •Innovation: fresh thinking, new approaches to service delivery.

One of Garnica Facility Services main assets are our employees, as they interact with our clients on a daily basis and determine customer service experience levels. 
Our Human Resources policies and procedures focus on:
•Define strict recruiting procedures. •Invest in training programmes. •Invest in personnel motivation and career development programmes.
